    Hochschild classes and mesh corrections (Proposition 7.6, the map Ψ) #

    weights-and-parameters.tex (prop:hochschild-mesh-restriction): "Represent a homogeneous class by a normalized relative cocycle μ. Apply Lemma 6.6 with R = k, Λ = A₀ and the normalized modules, using Lemma 6.3. Choose the actual projectives at their labels, give ε degree −q, and lift the arrows homogeneously to the Hom category of the lifted modules. Each mesh error reduces to zero, so by the freeness in Lemma 6.6 it is ε times a map of the original category. Thus the mesh errors are εz_v with z_v ∈ C_{q+2}(τv, v). Changing the arrow lifts by εf_a changes their tuple by D_{q+1}f."

    Here: the arrow maps fA on evaluated modules, the choice data LiftData (module lifts and arrow lifts), the mesh error zE, its representative zhat ∈ C_{q+2}(τx, x), and the class Ψ ∈ coker D_{q+1}.
